raw_response:
Answer: E
Reason: The chest X-ray shows diffuse peri-bronchial thickening and faint nodular opacities, which are characteristic pulmonary findings of COVID-19; gastrointestinal symptoms like nausea and epigastric pain can occur in COVID-19 even without prominent respiratory complaints. Options A, B, C, and D describe abdominal pathologies that would not produce these specific lung imaging findings.
